verdict.title: Quick recommendation
verdict.body_html: Compare Passo if you want a newer Palm Jumeirah luxury option with project-specific payment, availability and layout checks. Compare Orla if your priority is ultra-prime positioning, Omniyat-style luxury and established high-end Palm Jumeirah perception. The final choice should be made only after live price, unit, view, payment plan and availability checks.

segment_logic.title: Comparison logic
segment_logic.body: Project comparison pages should only compare logical pairs. Primadom AI should score projects by buyer budget, exact unit type, view, price per sqft, payment plan, handover, developer, amenities, service charges, rental logic, resale liquidity and lifestyle fit.

rows.area_a: Use live price list and available unit stack. Good comparison only if exact size, view and payment terms are known.
rows.area_b: Usually needs ultra-prime budget validation; compare current stock, resale/liquidity and total cost carefully.

rows.area_a: Palm Jumeirah waterfront context; compare exact plot, access, view corridors and beach/amenity logic.
rows.area_b: Palm Jumeirah ultra-prime context; compare privacy, frontage, view, access and completed/neighbouring luxury supply.

rows.area_a: Check booking amount, construction-linked payments, post-handover exposure and final cashflow.
rows.area_b: Check payment stages, premium pricing, service-charge exposure and resale flexibility.

rows.area_a: Production version should show verified handover date and construction status.
rows.area_b: Production version should show verified delivery/status and whether ready/resale/off-plan logic applies.

rows.area_a: Compare apartments, penthouses or residences by layout, balcony, view, floor and usable area.
rows.area_b: Compare residences by layout quality, privacy, branded/luxury positioning and service expectations.

rows.area_a: May fit buyers looking for newer luxury waterfront positioning and specific availability.
rows.area_b: May fit buyers prioritizing established ultra-prime luxury and status-led living.

rows.area_a: Depends on entry price, payment plan, scarcity, handover, rental demand and resale story.
rows.area_b: Depends on premium entry, brand/developer perception, limited supply, liquidity and holding costs.

rental_logic.title: Investment logic
rental_logic.body: Investment choice should not be based on brand or render alone. The page must compare price per sqft, payment schedule, completion risk, unit scarcity, service charges, rental demand, likely exit audience and competing Palm Jumeirah inventory.

items.question: Is Passo better than Orla?
items.answer: It depends on buyer goal. Passo may suit buyers comparing newer luxury waterfront options and project-specific terms, while Orla may suit buyers focused on ultra-prime positioning and Omniyat-style luxury. Final choice requires live price, availability and unit comparison.

items.question: Which project is better for investment?
items.answer: Investment comparison should depend on entry price, unit size, view, payment plan, handover, service charges, rental demand and resale liquidity rather than project name alone.

items.question: Which project is better for lifestyle?
items.answer: Both are luxury Palm Jumeirah projects, but lifestyle fit depends on exact building, view, amenities, privacy, unit layout, beach access and buyer preference.

items.question: Can Primadom AI compare both for my budget?
items.answer: Yes. Primadom AI can compare Passo and Orla by budget, unit type, view, payment plan, timeline, lifestyle goal and risk profile.
